mcpConnect.title: Connect an AI agent

importMcp.title: Use an AI agent
importMcp.description: Connection instructions and ready-to-copy prompts now live in the dedicated MCP guide.

mcpGuidePage.pageDescription: Give ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or another remote MCP client safe draft-only access to your Echo decks.
mcpGuidePage.connectionDescription: Use one OAuth-protected endpoint. Sign-in ensures every client can access only your account.
mcpGuidePage.publicRequired: A public HTTPS URL is required
mcpGuidePage.publicDescription: The current origin is {origin}. Remote clients cannot connect to localhost.
mcpGuidePage.oauthMissing: OAuth discovery is not fully configured
mcpGuidePage.endpointHint: Add this exact URL. OAuth opens Echo sign-in and consent; never append a token.
mcpGuidePage.allowedDecks: Read your deck names and languages
mcpGuidePage.allowedContracts: Read the exact field contract for a deck
mcpGuidePage.clientsDescription: Choose your client and follow its current remote MCP flow.
mcpGuidePage.chatgptAvailability: Custom MCP apps require a supported ChatGPT plan and developer mode.
mcpGuidePage.chatgptStep1: Enable developer mode in ChatGPT Apps settings.
mcpGuidePage.chatgptStep2: Create a custom app and paste the Echo endpoint.
mcpGuidePage.chatgptStep3: Choose OAuth, scan tools, then authorize your Echo account.
mcpGuidePage.chatgptStep4: Open a new chat, select the Echo app, and start with the guide prompt below.
mcpGuidePage.claudeAvailability: Use a Claude surface that supports remote MCP connectors and OAuth.
mcpGuidePage.claudeStep1: Open the integrations or connectors settings for your Claude client.
mcpGuidePage.claudeStep2: Add a custom remote MCP server and paste the Echo endpoint.
mcpGuidePage.claudeStep3: Complete Echo sign-in and approve draft-only access.
mcpGuidePage.claudeStep4: Start a new conversation and ask Claude to call get_echo_guide.
mcpGuidePage.codexAvailability: Use the remote HTTP MCP configuration supported by your agent or editor.
mcpGuidePage.codexStep1: Open the agent's MCP server settings.
mcpGuidePage.codexStep2: Add an HTTP MCP server named Echo using the endpoint above.
mcpGuidePage.codexStep3: Complete OAuth in the browser window opened by the client.
mcpGuidePage.codexStep4: Verify the tools list, then start with get_echo_guide.
mcpGuidePage.genericAvailability: The client must support remote HTTP MCP and OAuth discovery.
mcpGuidePage.genericStep1: Create a remote HTTP MCP connection.
mcpGuidePage.genericStep2: Paste the endpoint exactly, without a token query parameter.
mcpGuidePage.genericStep3: Complete OAuth and allow the requested Echo permissions.
mcpGuidePage.promptsDescription: Copy a template, then replace the bracketed details.
mcpGuidePage.guideDescription: Start safely and let the agent discover the contract.
mcpGuidePage.guidePrompt: Connect to Echo, call get_echo_guide, list my decks, and explain which tools you can use. Do not create drafts yet.
mcpGuidePage.topicDescription: Generate a focused batch for one deck.
mcpGuidePage.topicPrompt: Use Echo MCP. Find my [LANGUAGE] deck named [DECK NAME], call get_deck_contract, then create [COUNT] [CEFR LEVEL] draft notes about [TOPIC]. Follow the returned field options exactly. Do not publish anything.
mcpGuidePage.reviewDescription: Inspect the latest batch without changing approved notes.
mcpGuidePage.reviewPrompt: Use Echo MCP to list my latest draft batches for [DECK NAME]. Summarize the newest batch and tell me what to review in Echo. Do not approve, publish, or delete notes.

oauthConsent.title: Allow access?
oauthConsent.description: {client} wants to connect to your Echo account.
oauthConsent.readDecks: View your deck names, languages, and field contracts.
oauthConsent.readDrafts: View your draft batches and notes.
oauthConsent.createDrafts: Create new draft notes for your review.
oauthConsent.noPublish: It cannot approve, publish, or delete notes.
oauthConsent.invalidRequest: This authorization request is missing, invalid, or expired. Start the connection again from your MCP client.
